# M2-4: Financial snapshot and tax-bucket tags

- Milestone: M2
- Branch / worktree: `t/M2-4`, `../YNAB_AutoCategorizer.wt/M2-4`
- Depends on: M2-2
- Touches (exclusive while running): mcp/ (own files `tools_snapshot*.go`), store/ (migration + read queries in new files),
  cmd/ (new subcommand file)
- Plan refs: §2 accounts `tax_bucket`, R9a, G6, STATE Decisions 2026-10-29 (category list is PROPOSED)
- YNAB access: none
- Deploy: no

## Goal
`get_financial_snapshot` (R9a) over the current plan, plus `get_goals` and `get_income_events`, and a local way to tag
accounts by tax bucket.

## Scope
- Migration: `accounts.tax_bucket`, local-only. A sync must never overwrite it (add a test against the upsert path).
- `finbot tag-account <account name> <bucket>` and listing of current tags, with buckets taxable, traditional, roth, hsa,
  cash, none. Names, not ids.
- `get_financial_snapshot`: balances by account and tax bucket (untagged shown as `untagged`, never guessed), debt terms
  from the mirror's debt fields, average monthly income and spend, savings rate, goal progress from category targets.
- CSP grouping: the final category list isn't decided. Group by YNAB category group, and expose any CSP labelling only as
  an explicit PROPOSED field. Rename nothing, create nothing in YNAB.
- Report the averaging window and how much history it covers, because categorizing lapsed around 2025. Report uncategorized
  spend as its own figure so a stale plan can't look precise.

## Out of scope
- Anything writing to YNAB, profile data for retirement assumptions (no `profile` table yet), simulators.

## Acceptance (each must be demonstrably checked)
- [ ] Test: a tag survives a full sync and a delta touching that account.
- [ ] Fixture tests: bucket totals, debt terms, averages with an uneven window, uncategorized share, goal progress.
- [ ] Test: an untagged account appears as `untagged`.
- [ ] Test: all three tools include data freshness.
- [ ] `go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./...` green
